pub assume_specification<T, F: FnMut(&T, &T) -> core::cmp::Ordering>[
    <[T]>::sort_unstable_by::<F>
](slice: &mut [T], compare: F)
    requires
        forall|a: T, b: T|
            old(slice)@.contains(a) && old(slice)@.contains(b)
                ==> compare.requires((&a, &b)),
    ensures
        final(slice)@.to_multiset() == old(slice)@.to_multiset(),
;
